name: Crock Pot Chicken Baked Tacos
assumptions: Yield estimated from 12 hard taco shells (2 tacos per serving) plus 4-6 chicken breasts scaled to 5 average breasts yielding ~6 servings total
Total time aggregates 4 hours (240 min) crock-pot high cook + 15 min prep for sauces/toppings + 15 min bake + 15 min cooling/shredding
Vinaigrette assumed to contain dairy (creamy style) based on sour cream pairing and common ranch-style vinaigrettes
Hard taco shells assumed corn-based (no wheat) but left gluten-free as null due to possible cross-contamination or uncertified status
No explicit wheat, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients
Milk allergen from sour cream, cheese, and milk; dairy-free false due to multiple dairy items
Vegetarian/vegan/pescatarian false due to chicken breasts
instructions:
Put the uncooked chicken breasts in the crock pot. Pour the full bottle of salad dressing over the chicken. Sprinkle the rest of the ingredients over the top and mix them in a bit with a spoon.
Cover your crock pot with the lid and cook on high for 4 hours.
Remove all the chicken breasts from the crock pot and let cool.
Shred the chicken breasts and move to a glass bowl.
Pour most of the liquid over the shredded chicken.
FOR THE TACOS:
Make the guacamole sauce by mixing the avocado and green salsa together. Pour the guacamole mixture through a strainer until smooth and transfer to a squeeze bottle. Cut the tip off the lid of the squeeze bottle to make the opening more wide if needed.
Make the sour cream sauce by mixing the sour cream and milk together until you get a more liquid sour cream sauce. Transfer to a squeeze bottle.
In a 9x 13 glass baking dish, fill all 12+ tacos with a layer of refried beans, cooked chicken and shredded cheese.
Bake at 450 for 10-15 minutes just until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Out of the oven top all the tacos with the sliced grape tomaotes, jalapeno and cilantro.
Finish with a drizzle of guacamole and sour cream.
Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Chicken Breasts
ingredients.assumptions: 4-6 chicken breasts averaged to 5 medium boneless skinless breasts at ~160g each; raw weight used as entire line input before cooking and shredding

ingredients.name: Vinaigrette Dressing
ingredients.assumptions: Full bottle of typical creamy vinaigrette salad dressing (e.g. ranch-style) assumed at standard 12 oz / 355 ml bottle with ~350 g edible contents; recipe uses entire bottle over chicken

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.assumptions: 1.5 tablespoons ground cumin; standard density ~5.3 g per tbsp

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon smoked paprika; standard density ~6 g per tbsp

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 1 teaspoon minced or granulated garlic; ~3 g per tsp

ingredients.name: Refried Beans
ingredients.assumptions: 1 standard 16 oz / 454 g can refried beans, using full drained edible contents ~250 g after typical liquid

ingredients.name: Hard Taco Shells
ingredients.assumptions: 12 standard hard corn taco shells at ~15 g each; entire package used as recipe calls for 12+

ingredients.name: Shredded Mexican Cheese
ingredients.assumptions: 2 cups pre-shredded Mexican cheese blend; standard 8 oz / 226 g bag approximated to 220 g usable

ingredients.name: Grape Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Grape tomatoes halved for topping ~12-15 tomatoes or 1.5 cups; plausible recipe amount ~150 g edible portion

ingredients.name: Jalapeno
ingredients.assumptions: 1-2 seeded sliced jalapenos for topping; estimated total edible 30 g

ingredients.name: Avocado
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large avocado peeled and sliced for guacamole base; typical edible flesh ~150 g

ingredients.name: Green Salsa
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons green salsa / salsa verde; standard density ~15 g per tbsp

ingredients.name: Sour Cream
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons full-fat sour cream; standard density ~15 g per tbsp

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon milk (2% assumed); standard density ~15 g per tbsp
